desc: 长版开襟薄针织，正身垂坠与落肩两穿，贴袋织纹细节
leaf: 女式轻薄长版针织开衫
name: 女式浅芋轻薄针织开衫垂坠款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼拿下点击，用冷白上身底交代长版开襟与垂坠廓形。
用衣帽间出街场景完成代入，证明薄针织可作日常外搭层。
一秒给出核心利益：同一件可正穿也可落肩，主图一秒法则。
补上后背信息，消除肩线、后片长度与廓形疑虑。
微距特写纱线织面与贴袋收边，用可见做工替代空口品质话术。
以叠装平整度与领口袖口收边收口，用空白证明位降低下单风险。

style.backgroundSystem: cool seamless studio white #FFFFFF for the packshot, pale lilac mist #ECE6F4 plaster for scene and closing screens, warm cream #FAF6EE for the benefit hero, one misty taro #C7B9DF panel for the back-view and macro screens; flat matte fields only, no gradient, no wood, no sand tones
style.direction: premium lilac-mist women's lightweight knit ecommerce
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin line icons and dotted leader lines in misty taro #C7B9DF, unlettered rounded callout pills and empty stamp frames, no filled glyphs, no badges, no stars
style.lightingSystem: bright neutral high-key studio light from a large frontal source with a left fill card, low skimming side light only where the knit face, the front edge and the pocket mouth must read, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars, no coloured gels
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium lilac-mist women's lightweight knit visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cool seamless studio white #FFFFFF, warm cream #FAF6EE, pale lilac mist #ECE6F4, one misty taro accent #C7B9DF and aubergine ink #443E50; bright neutral high-key studio light from a large frontal source with a left fill card, low skimming side light only where the knit face, the front edge and the pocket mouth must read, soft contact shadows and no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif with wide tracking in a single family; single-weight thin-line icon style with unlettered rounded callout pills and empty stamp frames; matte seamless paper and pale plaster surfaces, no wood, no sand, no gradient; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable straight-on or slight 3/4 on-body garment angle with an identical crop line, drape and scale, model always generic with the face cropped below the chin or turned away; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no colour palette changes away from #FFFFFF, #FAF6EE, #ECE6F4, #C7B9DF and #443E50
no mixed fonts, serif or handwritten type
no random backgrounds, warm wood, sand or foliage surfaces, no gradient backdrops
no inconsistent lighting, coloured gels or warm cast between screens
no filled icons, badges, stars or certification seals
no identifiable model face, brand wordmark or hangtag lettering
style.presentationRules: on-body garment kept at a stable straight-on or slight 3/4 angle with an identical crop line, front edges and side pockets always readable, garment never re-proportioned between screens, model always generic with the face cropped below the chin or turned away, no mannequin and no floating garment
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper and pale plaster in matching lilac-grey tones, warm cream #FAF6EE panels carrying the flat layouts, deep aubergine #443E50 board behind the macro screen, no wood, no stone, no foliage
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif in one family with wide tracking, any lettering left as empty reserved plates and pills, no serif, script or hand lettering
